# Motion › Split

**What belongs here.** The frame divides into rigid slices that move apart or together.

**Examples.** split-screen slide, shutter halves

**Family test.** Do the pixels keep their shape while they move?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Shutter](shutter/) | The old scene splits into two halves that slide apart like doors, with the new scene behind them. |
| [Slice In](slice-in/) | The new scene arrives in vertical slices that slide up into place one after another. |
| [Split Slices](split-slices/) | The old scene breaks into horizontal slices that slide off alternately left and right, showing the new scene behind. |
